title: fix(components): action:button renders no text for a non-string label instead of crashing the page
body:
Fixes #36717
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 页面上的操作按钮，文字若不是字符串（例如代码注册、没过校验的页面里写成多语言对象），以前整页白屏；现在按钮照常显示并可点击，只是不显示文字，开发环境会提示一次。字符串文字的显示与翻译和以前完全一样。
- 执行维护者裁决「保持走翻译包」（选项 A）：按钮文字仍只接受字符串，靠翻译包里该组件的条目翻译；本次只加渲染防护，不翻译多语言对象，也不改协议。
- 出错的后果：最坏是那个按钮没有文字，页面其余部分不受影响；改动可直接撤回。另有一处行为变化：以前写成数字的按钮文字会照样显示，现在同样不显示并提示一次（协议本来就只接受字符串）。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-button.tsx`: every read of `schema.label` goes through one guard, `renderableLabel`. A string label is returned unchanged. Any other value (an inline locale map from metadata that skipped `validateComponentProps`) becomes no label: the button renders with no text and still runs its action, nothing prints `[object Object]`, and a development build logs one `console.warn` per component, keyed on the component id, naming the bundle key `pages.PAGE.components.COMPONENT_ID.label`. The dev warning follows the existing `process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'` pattern in `auto-trigger.ts`. The value is never translated, so a value the contract refuses gets no meaning.

The guard covers all five label reads in the file: the `visible` diagnostic label, the `label` forwarded to the runner (the param dialog's title), the icon spacing class, the rendered text, and the subject handed to `useAutoTriggerOnce`. That hook builds its user-facing refusal toast and toast id from the label, so it now gets the guarded label (`{ ...schema, label }` when they differ).

Ruling: option A (7118756694), the maintainer's 「保持走翻译包」. `label` stays `z.string()` and `packages/spec` is untouched.

Responsibility:
- whose code: the platform's own `@object-ui/components` `action:button` renderer;
- existing platform path: the translation bundle key for the component id, which is the contract and already translates a string label;
- who reaches it: pages whose metadata skipped `validateComponentProps` (for example code-registered pages) and carry a non-string label.

## Tests

A new top-level `describe` for #36717 in the existing action-button harness `action-button-icon-inputs-11168.test.tsx`, which mounts the node through the real `SchemaRenderer` and `ActionProvider`:
- an object label renders the button with empty text, shows no `[object Object]` and neither locale string, and a second mount of the same component does not warn again (exactly one warning, which names the component id);
- an object label still runs the action, and the runner gets no label;
- an object label on a hidden `autoTrigger` button gives a refusal toast whose message and id carry no `[object Object]` (it names the action by `name`), and no console warning carries it either;
- CONTROL: a string label renders and is forwarded to the runner;
- CONTROL: a string label translated by `translatePage` through `pages.billing.components.buy_credits.label` renders `购买额度`.

## Acceptance notes

- Behaviour change: a numeric label (for example `5`) rendered as text before this PR. It is now dropped like any other non-string label, with the same dev warning. The contract (`z.string()`) already refuses it, so this follows ruling A.
- Same defect family, out of this card's reach: `action:menu`, `action:group` and `action:icon` also render a non-string label raw, and `action:menu` throws on a locale map. The follow-up is #37266.
- The dev warning is keyed on the component id, then `name`. A button with neither shares the fallback key `action:button`, so only the first such button warns.
- A button with a non-string label and no icon has no accessible name. That follows from the ruling's "render no text", and the dev warning names the fix.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-button-icon-inputs-11168.test.tsx -t "non-string label"`. Expected: 5 passed.

<details><summary>Ablation of the auto-trigger hand-off (head fce37f7)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put back `useAutoTriggerOnce(schema, isVisible, handleClick)` (anchor 1 to 0, blob 60bb1f196925 to 426c38142ef3). Result: 1 failed, 4 passed. The failure: `expected '"[object Object]" is not available on…' not to contain '[object Object]'`. After the restore, the blob equals HEAD (60bb1f196925) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

The first version of this pin (da40a35) mounted the node through `SchemaRenderer`. Its node gate hides a `visible: false` node before the renderer mounts, so the hook never ran and the toast was never called; that failed the same way locally and in CI. It was a mounting error, not timing. The pin now mounts the registered renderer directly, which is the path `action:bar` takes.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (guard reverted, head e8894fd)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the guard's string check with `return label as string | undefined;`. The anchor went from 1 to 0 hits and the blob from 212e6892b2cc to 4aa3e1708bd4. Result: 2 failed, 2 passed. Both object-label tests threw "Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {en, zh-CN})", which is the defect as it is on main. Both controls stayed green. After the restore, the blob equals HEAD (212e6892b2cc) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites and gates (round 1 head e13c940; round 2 head fce37f7 below)</summary>

- Round 2 at fce37f7: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check && vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/action/` gave 37 files and 619 tests passed (VERDICT command-exit 0). The harness file gave 60/60.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` passed, chained with `&&` before `vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/action/` (38 files, 626 tests passed). VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Full `packages/components/` suite on e8894fd: 510 files passed, 1 skipped; 4970 tests passed. The only later code change is the warning key (`dataObjId`), and the action-renderer directory was re-run on the final head.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 38 families derived and run; `--ran` accounted for all 38. 37 exited 0 on e13c940. `vitest run scripts/` had one 15 s timeout under box contention (`js-comment-mask-returns-interpolation-9424`). That file passed on re-run under the lock on the final head.
- NOT MEASURED locally: the CI type-check lanes the derivation lists as CI-only, the CI-measured-only families, and Test UI shards beyond `packages/components`.
</details>
